name: Willet
desc: Willet (Tringa semipalmata): hunts or scavenges other animals. Recorded 78 times near the park in GBIF.
about: The saltmarsh willet or willet is a large shorebird in the family Scolopacidae. It is a relatively large and robust sandpiper and is the largest of the species called "shanks" in the genus Tringa.
